title: Looks cheesy plastic, if you can’t use the top tier in a cupboard it’s useless, will Not lay flat.
text:
Looks cheesy plastic, if you can’t use the top tier in a cupboard it’s useless, will Not lay flat.. This is my 3rd review, as my other reviews are Not a Glowy review as the others are and it keeps disappearing !!
So I’ll make it fast, and hopes it does not disappear!

This is Too tall for under my kitchen counter for our family vitamins.
If you can’t use the second tier it is totally useless cause it will not lay flat , there is the connection under it.
It’s a waste.
I would Not leave this out on my kitchen counter cause it’s cheesy looking , or on my bathroom counter, it’s cheesy.
And takes up too much room.

I have a big walk in pantry, still too tall except for the top shelve, or the bottom , then I can’t read the bottles or it’s too
Tall on the top shelve for me to reach.

Thought of the garage For my husbands little stuff but might fall over.
Before buying this measure your cabinets.

product_metadata.title: Asojoy 2-Tier Non Skid Lazy Susan Adjutable Height Up To 14.6'' 11.42'' Dia Base Tutntable Cabinet Organizer With Bins For Kitchen Pantry Snack Fruit Makeup Storage (Lasy Susan with Grey Bins)
features: 360° FREE ROTATION-The lasy susan is designed with a rotatable base which can go 360 degrees smoothly and with no noise. It helps you easily access to the stuffs stored in the organizer, especially when you are busy with cooking or doing make-up. It does not bother you too much searching for a spice bottle or an eye-shadow.

STEPLESS ADJUSTABLE HEIGHT-The height of the rotatable cabinet organizer can be adjusted from 7.8'' to 11.8'' by simply pulling over the trigger and holding the upper tire of the spice rack up or down according to your own requirements. It solves the problem for traditional susans not being able to store bottles with long neck.

2 TIRE SNACK ORGANIZER WITH DETACHABLE BINS-The makeup organizer has 2 tires. Upper tire is equipped with a large round bin and the lower tire is setteled with 3 fan-shaped bins. All the bins are detachable, which makes it quite easy to clean.

WIDE APPLICATIONS-The turntable organizer can be used as a spice rack, a make-up organizer, a snack tray or organizer, a fruit tray or a small stuffs organizer on desktop. They are suitable to be used in any locations at home, in kithchen, pantry, refrigerator, bedroom, living room or on desktop, table.
RINSED EDGES AND NON-SLIP BOTTOM: Deep rinsed edges prevent bottles falling off. Non-slip bottom makes the lazy susan sturdy and well organized.
